component.name: Move Mouse
component.summary: Keep your session alive by simulating user activity

description.p: Move Mouse simulates user activity by moving the mouse cursor at configurable intervals, preventing your session from locking or the screensaver from activating during long unattended tasks.

ul.li: 15 cursor movement directions including circular motion
Configurable interval with optional random range
Auto-pause when real user activity is detected
Auto-resume after a configurable idle period
System tray icon with AppIndicator3 support
Screensaver inhibition via GNOME session API

description.p: Initial Linux release. Full port of the original Windows Move Mouse application.

ul.li: GTK3 UI with system tray support
All 26 settings from the original Windows app
